typographyRecommendations.note: Recommendations are separate from visual measurements. The raster does not establish an exact family. The customer proposed Roboto and Helvetica/Inter; Inter and Roboto both provide 400, 500, 600 and 700 weights. Inter Tight is an additional display candidate for the compact heading, not an identification.

assumptions: All CSS rem conversions assume a 16px root size.
Text boxes generally describe visible ink or the stated line-box group; font family, exact weight and tracking cannot be proved by the raster.
The heading font size and letter spacing are estimates constrained by the measured 128px line pitch and visible word widths.
Gradient stop positions are an implementation interpolation between sampled colours, not recovered source CSS.
Rotated service-label boxes are axis-aligned visible bounds. Their unrotated dimensions and pixel inset-block-start/inset-inline-start values are inferred using centre transform origins.
Code-xml and network icon angles are not reliably readable; suggested angles must not be treated as measurements.
The board is clipped on the right and bottom; its complete original dimensions are unknown.
The bottom hero corner geometry is not visible because the hero reaches the canvas bottom.
The drop-menu's open state is not depicted; menu panel size, position, colours and typography are unmeasured.
No mobile screen is supplied. Stacking left, hero, then services is a customer requirement, not a measured responsive layout.
No crop files have been written in this pass, so region crop fields are null. The harness can cut these boxes from the named sub-reference.
Existing layer PNGs remain decomposition hints only; none was substituted for the full-screen measurement source.
notes: The overall layout and panel boundaries are readable; small glyph rotations, obscured services copy and exact typography limit the sheet to medium confidence.
All element and region source fields intentionally name landing.png so subsequent crops are taken from the flat screen.

The reference must not be used as a full-page background or screenshot. Only the chess piece, board and reconstructed badge are artwork assets; type, controls, panels, labels and gradient remain HTML/CSS/SVG.
